landing.hero: The service book your car deserves
landing.sub: Track every repair, follow your car through the shop in real time, and never miss maintenance again. With a friendly AI mechanic and a Telegram bot for quick updates.
landing.f1: Share a link with your mechanic. Watch status, photos and costs update. Approve extra work with one tap.
landing.f2: Every oil change, part and receipt in one beautiful timeline. Export it when you sell the car.
landing.f3: Torque learns how much you drive and predicts what's due next — by distance and by date.
landing.f4: Send “/km 84500” to the bot. Ask the assistant “what's due on my Golf?”. Bring your own AI key.
landing.wsSub: Keep a job board for your team, check cars in with the customer's QR code, ask for approval of extra work and keep customers updated automatically. Free.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Please read this before using Torque. It explains what the app does, what it doesn't do, and who is responsible for decisions about your vehicle.
terms.what: Torque is a personal record-keeping tool. It stores your service history, estimates upcoming maintenance, lets a workshop post updates through a link you share, and offers an optional AI assistant. Torque is not a workshop, a licensed mechanic, an inspector or an insurer, and it does not repair, inspect or certify vehicles.
terms.decisions: You alone decide whether, when and how to maintain, repair, drive or stop using your vehicle, which workshop to use, and which work to approve or pay for. You accept all risks and consequences of those decisions, including damage to your vehicle or other property, costs, injury and legal liability. Always follow your vehicle manufacturer's instructions and have safety-critical systems checked by a qualified professional.
terms.ai_t: 3. The AI assistant is not professional advice
terms.ai: The assistant generates text automatically and can be wrong, incomplete or out of date. Its answers about symptoms, causes, urgency, prices or whether a car is safe to drive are general information only. Do not rely on it for brakes, steering, tyres, suspension, airbags, fuel leaks, overheating, warning lights or high-voltage (EV/hybrid) systems: stop and get a professional inspection. You review and confirm every action the assistant proposes, and you are responsible for the result.
terms.estimates: Due dates, mileage predictions, health scores and notifications are calculated from the data you enter and may be inaccurate, late or not delivered at all. They do not replace your vehicle's service schedule or your own judgement.
terms.thirdParties: Workshops that use your shared link, Telegram, your AI provider and email services are independent third parties. Torque is not responsible for their work, prices, statements, availability or how they handle your data. You use your own AI key at your own cost and under that provider's terms.
terms.data: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you enter and for keeping your own copies of important documents (you can print or save your service history at any time). Torque runs on free hosting and is provided as is, without guarantees of availability, accuracy or fitness for a particular purpose.
terms.liability: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Torque and its authors are not liable for any direct or indirect loss or damage arising from your use of the app, the AI assistant, reminders, or third-party services, or from decisions you make based on them.
